name: PeopleOS · Migration review with human handoff

parameters.content:
## PeopleOS · Migration review
Set **Configure demo → baseUrl** to your running PeopleOS service.

Uses synthetic data. No credentials are bundled. A fresh session cookie is forwarded between API calls.

This workflow ends at an approval proposal. Its session is independent of the website browser.

## A deliberate handoff
The backend executes deterministic data checks. Optional Groq explains their results.

Inspect the final output before choosing whether to send a separate approval request. No employee data changes in this workflow.
